column2: as staff would write them. days_ago: 0 = created when the data is loaded.
Arcot Road main burst near Vadapalani; CMWSSB Depot 10 crew on site. Supply to Kodambakkam (Zone 10) suspended until the repair is done.
Latest test at Veeranam shows BOD 8.0 mg/L, above the CPCB limit of 3 mg/L. Increase treatment at Vadakuthu WTP and retest.
Vaigai reservoir is at 14.4 % (WRD bulletin, 10 Oct 2026). Madurai Central supply reduced to 60 % of demand; plan tanker support for the hospital request.
